settings.content: Controls the whole checkout column at once: Buy now, Add to cart, and Shopify's own Buy it now button. Shopify paints Buy it now from its brand colour and ignores the theme, so it is overridden here to match the other two — change these and all three stay in step.

settings.label: Primary button rim
settings.info: Set it the same as the button to hide the rim.

settings.label: Cart count badge
settings.info: The number bubble on the cart icon. Kept loud on purpose - it is a state indicator, not brand chrome.

settings.content: Controls the Track your build page. Only IDs listed here can see a tracking view. One rider per line:  ID : stage : city : latitude : longitude : date  — that is  ID : stage : city : latitude : longitude : date the current stage started.  Stages: 1 Order confirmed, 2 Preparing your order, 3 Key out for delivery, 4 Final shakedown, 5 Bike out for delivery, 6 Delivered. The date is what fills the progress bar on the active stage, so update it whenever you move someone forward.

settings.label: Rider roster
settings.info: Leave empty until there are real orders. Never list a rider who has not actually ordered - invented fulfilment data is fabricated social proof.
